why: Regression fixture for #219: Wiley (Quantitative Biology) commentary whose 20 pretty-printed <mixed-citation>s close every <string-name> on a line of its own before the `,` or `.` that follows it, and put a line break between `</collab>` and its `.`. That formatting whitespace is dropped, so the names read `Li X, Shi J, Li LM.` and the consortium `The UniProt Consortium.`, while the spacing the citation text itself carries is kept. Its nine inline formulas are MathML alone and read in the TeX-style linear form, the entropy sums keeping their limits and subscripts (#207). Its acknowledgements and data statement follow the body as back-matter sections (#206).
